original_paper.title: Clustering Validity Assessment: Finding the optimal partitioning of a data set
original_paper.read_via: author-uploaded ResearchGate full paper; web extraction

visual_formula_check.title: An Introduction to Quality Assessment in Data Mining; Halkidi/Vazirgiannis PKDD August 2002
visual_formula_check.method: local Poppler rendered PDF pages69/70 viewed; page71 population-variance definition extracted

feature_scope: frozen A5 z-scores of mean monthly category share, 24months2023-2024; no rescaling

formula.density: closed Euclidean ball, distance <= radius; raw counts, not divided by cluster size
formula.Dens_bw: mean over unordered i<j of density(midpoint)/max(density(centre_i),density(centre_j)); equals ordered sum/(k*(k-1))
formula.S_Dbw: Scat + Dens_bw; lower is preferable under this declared convention

primary_centre_sample_domain: pair_union: literal shared C_i union C_j sample domain from eq2
sensitivity_centre_sample_domain: own_cluster: numerator still pair_union; centre counts own cluster
degenerate_rules: reject missing/non-finite, zero total variance, k<2 or k>=n
keep singleton clusters, flag their zero variance
zero density denominator in any pair => Dens_bw/S_Dbw null (NA), no epsilon/zero substitution
outcome_scope: descriptive saved partition evaluation; no economic truth/forecast/causal claim; no retuning
